question: Which present day Indian state came into existence as the Mysore state in 1953?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **After Independence, the Mysore State was created in 1953, wherein all the Kannada dominant areas under different dispensations were unified and the enlarged Mysore state was carved in 1956 and was renamed Karnataka in 1973.**
 
• It is celebrated as **Unification day.**
 
• **Karnataka**__
 
 
• Capital - Bangalore
 
• Chief Minister - Basavaraj Bommai** (As of March 2022)**.
 
• Governor - Thawar Chand Gehlot (As of March 2022).
 
• State bird - Indian roller
 
• State animal - Indian Elephant
 
• State tree - Sandalwood
 
• State flower - Lotus
 
• National parks - Anshi National Park, Bandipur National Park, Bannerghatta National Park, Kudremukh National Park, Nagarahole National Park.
